1: Aey Rasool ﷺ, keh dijiye: “Main subah ke Rubb ki panaah maangta hoon aur usi se hifazat chahta hoon.”
2: “Us tamam makhlooq ke shar se jo nuqsan pahunchati hai.”
3: “Aur main Allah ki panaah maangta hoon un sharron se jo raat mein zahir hote hain, yani mozi jaanwar aur rehzan.”
4: “Aur main us ki panaah maangta hoon un jaadugarniyon ke shar se jo girhon mein phoonkti hain.”
5: “Aur main us ki panaah maangta hoon hasad karne wale ke shar se, jab woh apne hasad ka izhar kare.”
